name: Cryptocurrency Icons
about: Cryptocurrency Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 489 icons designed by Christopher Downer. Covers popular cryptocurrencies and payment symbols for fintech apps and dashboards. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC0 1.0.

faqs.q: Are Cryptocurrency Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 489 Cryptocurrency Icons are open source under the CC0 1.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC0 1.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: Which coins do Cryptocurrency Icons cover?
faqs.a: Popular cryptocurrencies and payment symbols for fintech apps and dashboards. Search a coin or token name above to check that it's included.

faqs.q: How do I use Cryptocurrency Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Cryptocurrency Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 489 icons in the Cryptocurrency Icons set, designed by Christopher Downer. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Cryptocurrency Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
